name: recruiter-bff
description: A recruiter that works for you. Interview guides that open with the role, your fit, your gaps, and questions to ask; an apply-or-skip fit check for any posting; on-demand scans for fresh roles; a tracker with follow-ups, reminders, and a weekly review; resume and LinkedIn help in your voice; and your LinkedIn connections matched to your search. Plain files you own, no servers. Formerly Job Search Agent.
